learning_outcomes.text: Understand the power transfers in mechatronic systems and the notion of energy and their associated variables: storage and dissipation.
Understand the structure of a mechatronic system with all auxiliaries.
Analyze power transfers in mechatronic systems.

syllabus_topics: Energy and power at different scales
